subject: harbour operations console
brief: An operations console for a harbour master: vessel arrivals, berth assignments and weather observations. No animation. Dense readable tables, keyboard actions, no invented live feed.

subject: family funeral care
brief: A family funeral care service. Quiet human language, clear immediate contact and a plain explanation of arrangements. No invented testimonials, awards or pricing.

subject: children's science museum
brief: A children's science museum. Bright physical exhibits and family visit planning; opening hours, age guidance and accessible facilities before ticket selection. No software terminal or abstract finance charts.

subject: Arabic architecture studio
brief: An Arabic-first architecture studio portfolio. RTL content, projects and drawings, dark stone and warm white. Preserve the supplied custom typeface: Heading font: Studio Sans. No decorative pseudo-Arabic symbols.

subject: precision machine repair workshop
brief: A precision machine repair workshop for local manufacturers. Show supported machine types and a repair enquiry. White and black only, Helvetica only, no animation, no invented accreditation.
